subject: Redwood: Service Stability Brief & Customer Remediation Plan
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@finxpayments.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Cc: ops@finxpayments.com
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Incident: elevated error rate impacting FinX test transactions

Hi Connor,

We started seeing a spike in 5xx errors against Redwood inference endpoints around 08:45 PST this morning. Between 08:45 and 09:05 we observed a ~30% failure rate on our payment-intent scoring requests (p90 latency also jumped ~400ms). This is impacting buffered batch jobs and a handful of production requests.

We've collected request IDs and representative logs and attached a small sample (sample-logs.zip). Can you confirm whether this maps to any platform-side deployment or known config change? We need an initial timeline and immediate mitigation steps.

Thanks,
Maria Gomez
SRE, FinX Payments
maria.gomez@finxpayments.com

Attachments: sample-logs.zip (log bundle)
From: connor.obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@finxpayments.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Incident: elevated error rate impacting FinX test transactions

Hi Maria — thanks for the heads up and the logs. We're seeing correlated alerts from our autoscaling controller and a small upstream networking restart in one AZ at 08:40 PST.

Immediate actions we took:
- Rolled back a canary kernel change that had been pushed at 07:50 PST to the inference runtime on the affected pool.
- Temporarily pinned FinX traffic to an unaffected GPU pool to restore throughput while we investigate.
- Enabled extended request tracing for the next 2 hours to capture KV cache metrics and kernel selection logs.

Next steps I propose: 1) quick sync call to confirm impact window and affected routes, 2) share a concise timeline + RCA draft by EOD, 3) follow-up with a detailed remediation plan. Are you available for a 30m call at 11:30 PST?

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: connor.obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Incident notes from FinX — draft RCA and action items (internal)

Laura / Hannah —

Drafting the customer-facing RCA. Key findings so far (internal):
- Root cause: a partial regression in the kernel selector introduced higher contention on the KV cache under certain batch size distributions. The canary change altered an affinity heuristic (07:50 PST deployment).
- Contributing factor: a transient networking control-plane restart in us-west-2a (~08:40 PST) amplified cold-cache misses, increasing p90 latency and exposing the regression.
- Impact window: 08:45–09:12 PST (errors and elevated latencies), small blip of sustained elevated p90 through 09:30 while autoscaling stabilized. Estimated request failure rate peak ~30%.

Proposed customer action items to include in the final note:
1) RCA summary and timeline (one-pager).
2) Short-term mitigation already applied (rollback + traffic pin).
3) Medium-term: revert the affinity heuristic in the kernel selector and add a unit regression test.
4) Long-term: add a KV cache health signal and expand canary coverage to include representative FinX workload replay.
5) Compensation: offer one week of compute credits for measurable customer impact (discussion needed).

Can you review the draft timeline (attached spreadsheet) and the suggested language for the RCA PDF? I want to make sure we avoid technical jargon and present concrete commitments.

Connor

Attachments: timeline_20270208-20270212.csv (internal timeline)
From: connor.obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@finxpayments.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodpayments.com, hannah.schmitt@redwoodpayments.com, ops@finxpayments.com
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood: Service Stability Brief & Customer Remediation Plan

Hi Maria —

Thank you again for raising the alert and for the logs you provided. Attached is our customer-facing RCA and a concise timeline. Below is a short summary of findings and our concrete commitments.

Executive summary
- What happened: Between 08:45 and 09:12 PST on 2027-02-08, a kernel selector regression combined with a transient networking control-plane restart caused elevated p90 latency and a peak ~30% request failure rate for some FinX routes.
- Immediate mitigation: We rolled back the regression, pinned FinX traffic to an unaffected GPU pool, and restored normal error rates by ~09:15 PST.

Technical timeline (brief)
- 07:50 PST: Canary deployment of kernel selector heuristic (internal).
- 08:40 PST: Control-plane networking restart observed in us-west-2a (internal).
- 08:45–09:12 PST: Elevated error rate / latency observed for FinX routes.
- 08:50 PST: Autoscaling and routing adjustments made; rollback initiated.
- 09:15 PST: Normalization of error rates; monitoring continued through 12:00 PST.

Customer commitments and action items
1) Short-term (done): rollback of the kernel selector heuristic and traffic pinning to unaffected GPU pool (complete).
2) 1 week: run a targeted workload replay using FinX representative traces to validate stability; share results with your SRE team.
3) 2 weeks: ship a unit/regression test to prevent the kernel-affinity regression from landing in future canaries.
4) 4 weeks: implement a KV cache health metric and integrate it into our canary gating logic.
5) Compensation: we propose one week of compute credits to account for measurable impact; I'll route this to finance and confirm next steps.

Attachments: RCA_FinxPayments_20270212.pdf (RCA one-pager), timeline_20270208-20270212.csv (detailed event timeline)

Next steps
- I'm happy to walk through the RCA with your team; proposed slots: Mon 02/15 10:00–11:00 PST or Tue 02/16 14:00–15:00 PST. Please let me know which works.

Apologies for the disruption and thank you for your patience while we resolved the issue. We'll follow up on the credit proposal and the replay results per the schedule above.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132
